evidence: server.js:78-102, server.js:144-147, server.js:18-28, express-session@1.15.6 session/cookie.js:26-28 and README 'cookie.secure ... By default, the Secure attribute is not set'
justification: cookie.secure is never set (express-session leaves Secure off by default) and the app listens only via plain http.createServer, so the connect.sid session cookie is transmitted in cleartext and can be sniffed and replayed exactly as described. The root cause is the HTTP-only deployment (secure:true alone would break sessions here), which the claim also tells the reader to fix; not among the documented entries supplied for this file.
